content.title: Amalgalich
content.body:
§lHow to Summon
    - Dimension: Midnight
    - Blocks Required:
      1. (1) Undead Soulcube
      2. (16) Obsidian
      3. (4) Diamond Blocks
    
      - §lArrangement §r(Top-down POV)

    §lLayer 1-2:
    (X = Air, §lO §r= Obsidian)
    §lO §rX X X §lO
    X X X X X
    X X §lO §rX X
    X X X X X  
    §lO §rX X X §lO
    
    §lLayer 3:
    (§lS §r= Soulcube)
    §lO §rX X X §lO
    X X X X X
    X X §lS §rX X
    X X X X X  
    §lO §rX X X §lO
    
    §lLayer 4:
    (§lD §r= Diamond Block)
    §lD §rX X X §lD
    X X X X X
    X X §lO §rX X
    X X X X X  
    §lD §rX X X §lD
    
    §lLayer 5:
    X X X X X
    X X X X X
    X X §lO §rX X
    X X X X X  
    X X X X X

    After building the altar, use a §lSoul Key §rto trigger the fight.

    §lRecommended Gear
      1. Latest Armor for every class.
      2. Protection IV on most armor pieces.
      3. If possible, also enchant armor with Vitae and Vitality.
      4. Fully enchanted weapons (recommendation: Flangued Mace).
      5. Fully Upgraded Magic Wands of every element.
      6. Lots of healing.
      7. (Bonus) XP level 100 for 10% improvements to all stats.
    §lBossfight:
    Phase 1: Amalgalich summons Reapers and will sometimes start trying to suck everything up, this attack will instantly kill you if you get close enough. Any Reapers consumed will heal the Amalgalich. Tip: Do not jump or fly while the boss is performing this attack.
    Phase 2: Geists and giant Epions are summoned. Overtime, the Geists will grow until eventually bursting into large areas of Shadowfire (killing the Geists before they pop prevents this). If there's too much Shadowfire, killing the Epions will clear it beneath them.
    Phase 3: Amalgalich will start sucking things up again. Giant balls of Darklings are also lobbed around the arena. If there are too many Geists or Epions left from Phase 2, Amalgalich will eat them to regain health.
